title: Operational Workflow OS
brief: Unify jobs, scheduling, approvals, shortages, comments, attachments, and action queues into one operational workflow system so planners, leads, and managers can run the business from a coherent live command center.

phases.title: Workflow Coordination Core
phases.description: Build shared engines for approvals, comments, shortage triage, and workflow command-center orchestration.

units.title: Approval timeline + comment thread engines
entry_conditions: Job, traveler, and employee identities are canonical and live.
The desired approval, comment, and attachment lifecycle states are documented.
exit_conditions: Approvals and comments share a single event-aware timeline contract.
Attachments, @mentions, decisions, and acknowledgements can be tracked against any operational object.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Remove the new workflow engines and revert approval or comment handling to page-local state.

steps.instruction: Implement approval and comment engines that can target jobs, schedule studies, shortages, and shop-floor exceptions.
Normalize attachments, mentions, and audit events into one timeline format for downstream desks and notifications.
steps.validation: Every workflow record can emit one ordered timeline regardless of source page.

deliverables.description: Approval state, reviewer assignment, and audit timeline engine.
Operational comment threads with mentions, attachments, and event hooks.

units.description: Approval timeline + comment thread engines — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Workflow command center + shortage resolution engines
entry_conditions: Approval and comment state can be attached to operational records.
Shortage and exception signals from jobs and scheduling have been inventoried.
exit_conditions: A command center engine can aggregate approvals, shortages, blockers, and owner queues across domains.
A shortage engine can track demand, supply promise, escalation owner, and next action.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the command-center engines and restore separate queue logic in jobs and scheduling surfaces.

steps.instruction: Build a workflow command center engine that aggregates open work, blockers, approvals, and owner actions across jobs and scheduling.
Add shortage resolution logic for material, tooling, outside process, and information blockers with status and SLA fields.
steps.validation: Every blocker can be assigned, escalated, and cleared through one workflow contract.

deliverables.description: Unified operational queue aggregation and triage engine.
Shortage and blocker management engine with ownership and next actions.

units.description: Workflow command center + shortage resolution engines — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Workflow routes + jobs and scheduling desk integration
entry_conditions: Workflow command-center state is available through backend engines.
JobsPage and SchedulingPage already expose seeded desks ready for real data wiring.
exit_conditions: Workflow routes expose command-center, approval, shortage, and comment payloads.
The jobs and scheduling desks consume the same operational workflow language.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Unwire the command-center routes and return the desks to locally seeded workflow data.

steps.instruction: Expose workflow routes for command-center views, shortage updates, approval actions, and comment retrieval.
Refit the jobs and scheduling desks so selected records show command-center actions, comments, approvals, and shortage state from shared contracts.
steps.validation: Jobs and scheduling can hand records back and forth without losing owner or blocker context.

deliverables.description: HTTP route surface for workflow command-center, approvals, shortages, and comments.
Jobs desk integration with approvals, comments, shortages, and action queues.
Scheduling desk integration with workflow and blocker state.

units.description: Workflow routes + jobs and scheduling desk integration — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Jobs and scheduling share one workflow vocabulary for blockers, owners, comments, and approvals.
The workflow OS preserves record identity and history across cross-desk handoffs.

phases.title: Forge-Triple Workflow Surfaces
phases.description: Expose the workflow OS through command docs and add transition guardrails with integration coverage.

units.title: Workflow triage command + command-center template
entry_conditions: The workflow OS route names and transitions are stable.
The team needs a repeatable triage surface for planners and leads.
exit_conditions: A workflow triage command doc exists for approvals, blockers, and ownership queues.
A forge-triple workflow template exists for future command-center work.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Delete the command and template docs and rely on raw workflow API notes only.

steps.instruction: Write a workflow triage command doc covering blockers, approvals, reassignments, and resolution paths.
Create a command-center template that future milestones can reuse for queue, approval, and shortage prompts and payloads.
steps.validation: The command doc and template reference the shared workflow states and owner fields.

deliverables.description: Slash-command style guide for operational workflow triage and approvals.
Forge-triple template for workflow command-center prompts, queues, and transitions.

units.description: Workflow triage command + command-center template — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Workflow transition guard + integration suite
entry_conditions: Workflow command-center and triage docs are defined.
Transition rules for assignment, approval, and blocker closure are stable.
exit_conditions: A workflow transition guard blocks invalid moves or owner mismatches.
Integration coverage proves workflow actions stay coherent across jobs and scheduling desks.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the new transition guard if it blocks valid operations and revert to the old integration path.

steps.instruction: Implement a workflow transition guard that rejects invalid reassignment, approval, and blocker state changes.
Add an integration suite that proves comments, approvals, shortages, and desk handoffs remain synchronized.
steps.validation: The integration suite proves cross-desk workflow coherence and valid transition enforcement.

deliverables.description: Guardrail for workflow state transitions, reassignment, and approval moves.
Integration proof for command-center actions across jobs and scheduling desks.

units.description: Workflow transition guard + integration suite — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Every workflow state transition is documented and guarded.
Integration coverage proves shared command-center coherence across desks.
